competences.description: Attacks the enemy with the power of Yin and Yang and puts the enemy to sleep for 2 turns with a 20% chance. The damage increases according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times with each attack having a 75% chance to remove a beneficial effect of the enemy and a 75% chance to block the beneficial effects granted on the target for 2 turns. This attack will always land as a Critical Hit.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
All beneficial effects will be blocked
Attack will always land as a Critical Hit

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to steal their HP by 15% of your MAX HP and steal all beneficial effects on all enemies. Afterwards, increases the Attack Bar of all allies by 10%, and additionally by 10% if you successfully steal beneficial effects.

effets.description: Remove a beneficial effect and take it for yourself
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
